acceptanceCriteria: For a cited example, test-validity flags or refuses with a closed code when an asserted value is fully determined by a stub declared in the same example/group on a method reached by the code under test, or when a message-chain stub is asserted only on a prefix; the hint names the stub and the assertion; RSpec fixtures for both patterns plus a negative control; spec amended.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1339. Test-validity reports a cited example ELIGIBLE when a stub on the asserted path decides the outcome: (1) stubbed mutating operation plus a 'state unchanged' assertion; (2) receive_message_chain stub with only a prefix of the chain asserted. Blind review caught both; the tool did not.
title: Test validity: flag assertions made unfalsifiable by a stub on the asserted path
